meta.title: Night Market Bites
meta.instructions: Fifteen stalls, fifteen food questions. Tap the right answer before the lantern bar runs out: 100 a dish, plus a tip for answering fast. Take 2,700 before the last stall closes; three wrong calls and the lanterns go out.

verdict_line.body: if got_it() then (if tip > 0 then 'Fresh! +100, tip +' + str(tip) else 'Fresh! +100') else if picked < 0 then 'Too slow: ' + correct_answer() else 'It was ' + correct_answer()

node.visible: = locked and not got_it() and status == 'playing'

node.title: = if status == 'won' then 'Best night at the market' else if lives <= 0 then 'The lanterns went out' else 'Short of 2,700 tonight'
node.line: = str(right_count) + ' of ' + str(right_count + wrong_count) + ' right. Best tip: ' + str(best_tip)

score.measures: points for right answers plus speed tips

art.style: A warm night market: indigo sky, strings of paper lanterns, a noodle stall with steam and a striped awning, amber and mint light.
